why_text: Living with chronic conditions affects mood; your clinic supports your emotional wellbeing as part of your overall health.
template_en: Over the past 2 weeks, have you felt little interest or pleasure in doing things? (Optional - you can skip)
template_ur: گزشتہ 2 ہفتوں میں، کیا آپ نے کام کاج میں دلچسپی یا خوشی کی کمی محسوس کی ہے؟ (اختیاری سوال - آپ چھوڑ سکتے ہیں)
template_roman_ur: Pichle 2 hafto mein, kya aap ne kaam kaaj mein dilchaspi ya khushi ki kami mehsoos ki hai? (Optional - aap skip kar sakte hain)
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: To check if low mood has been affecting your daily energy.
template_en: Over the past 2 weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless? (Optional - you can skip)
template_ur: گزشتہ 2 ہفتوں میں، کیا آپ اداسی، مایوسی یا دل برداشتگی محسوس کر رہے ہیں؟ (اختیاری سوال)
template_roman_ur: Pichle 2 hafto mein, kya aap udasi, mayoosi ya dil bardashtagi mehsoos kar rahe hain? (Optional)
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: Managing diabetes or blood pressure daily can feel overwhelming, and your care team is here to help simplify things.
template_en: Have you felt overwhelmed by the daily demands of managing your condition? (Optional - you can skip)
template_ur: کیا آپ اپنی بیماری کی روزانہ دیکھ بھال اور دوائیوں سے بیزاری یا بوجھ محسوس کر رہے ہیں؟ (اختیاری سوال)
template_roman_ur: Kya aap apni bimari ki rozana dekh bhaal aur dawaiyon se bojh mehsoos kar rahe hain? (Optional)
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician
